(async () => { const list = await window.api.connections.list(); if (!list.ok) throw new Error('导入后列表失败'); if (list.data.length !== 2) throw new Error('导入后连接数应为 2，实际 ' + list.data.length); const withPassword = list.data.find((c) => c.hasCredential === true); if (!withPassword) throw new Error('没有一条连接 hasCredential=true（导入后还要手输密码）'); const without = list.data.find((c) => c.hasCredential !== true); if (!without) throw new Error('没有密码的那条连接不该被标成有密码'); const revealed = await window.api.credentials.reveal(withPassword.id); if (!revealed.ok) throw new Error('取密码失败: ' + revealed.error.message); if (revealed.data.status !== 'ok') throw new Error('密文状态不是 ok: ' + revealed.data.status); if (revealed.data.password !== 'ui-pass-b8-001') throw new Error('密码回填内容不对'); return { connections: list.data.length, hasCredential: true, password: 'matched', withoutCredential: without.name }; })()

(() => { if (document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]')) throw new Error('点完成后对话框未关闭'); if (document.querySelector('[data-rp-import-passphrase]')) throw new Error('口令对话框挂载点未清理'); return { closed: true, hostRemoved: true }; })()
